blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines — Two mall employees risked their jobs and their future for over P1,000 worth of personal necessities and T-shirts. And they lost them all after they were caught stealing, red-handed, these mall goods. As of this posting, the two mall employees remained detained at the Balamban Police Station detention cell, facing theft charges. Investigation showed that both men tried to take mall goods worth P1,028 by placing them in a sack and tried to bring them out as garbage from the mall last Friday, Nov. 13.
